hydration.name: Top up the water tanks
hydration.description: A glass of water with each meal keeps the crew hydrated.

exercise.name: Daily zero-g stretch
exercise.description: Twenty minutes of movement to keep the crew in flight shape.

sleep.name: Lights out on schedule
sleep.description: Head for the sleep pod at a set hour and let the ship power down.

reading.name: Study the ship's library
reading.description: Fifteen minutes with a book while the ship coasts.

mindfulness.name: Five minutes of radio silence
mindfulness.description: Sit still, breathe, and let the systems settle.

screentime.name: Power down the consoles
screentime.description: Screens off thirty minutes before the sleep cycle.

diet.name: Stock the galley with greens
diet.description: One portion of fruit or veg added to today's rations.

other.name: Daily mission check-in
other.description: A short daily status report on how the mission is going.
